svg.title: The Beast Crucible — Town-like camp blockout v2
svg.desc: An asymmetric town plan for the Beast Crucible camp. A low valley street bypasses the central Hearth Square, while districts climb through hills, terraces, stairs, and switchback roads.
svg.text: THE BEAST CRUCIBLE — TOWN-LIKE CAMP BLOCKOUT / V2
A civic square at the center of town, but a bypass street carries daily traffic around it
LOW VALLEY / ARRIVAL AND TRADE ROAD
WRIT WARD ROAD / DIRECT FROM VALLEY

g.text: Design rule: the Hearth is the town landmark, not the mandatory route.
Lower Valley Street carries traffic around the square; districts own their own streets.
Gate & Crafters' Hollow — supplies and forge
Command Ridge — high ground and defense
Resting Row — quiet reserve life and shade
Records / Writ Wards — long east-side walks
0–4s: gate / valley street / immediate civic space
8–15s: ridge, writ ward, overlooks, quiet edges
Every essential facility remains on a connected route.
